docs/source/es/tokenizer_summary.md:145:¿Qué significa esto exactamente? Refiriéndonos al ejemplo anterior, maximizar la probabilidad de los datos de entrenamiento es equivalente a encontrar el par de símbolos cuya probabilidad dividida entre las probabilidades de su primer símbolo seguido de su segundo símbolo es la mayor entre todos los pares de símbolos. *Ej.* `"u"` seguido de `"g"` solo habría sido combinado si la probabilidad de `"ug"` dividida entre `"u"` y `"g"` habría sido mayor que para cualquier otro par de símbolos. Intuitivamente, WordPiece es ligeramente diferente a BPE en que evalúa lo que _pierde_ al fusionar dos símbolos para asegurarse de que _valga la pena_.

"""Automatic "patch embedding fusion" registration.

Vision models often start with an ``nn.Conv3d`` patch embedding whose ``stride`` is equal to its ``kernel_size``.
Such a convolution applies a *non-overlapping* projection to each patch, which is mathematically equivalent to a
plain ``nn.Linear`` applied to the flattened patch. This module discovers these layers on a given model class and
registers everything needed to transparently replace the Conv3d by a Linear during inference:

- a *monkey-patch* that swaps the patch embedding module for a fused variant exposing a ``linear_proj`` `nn.Linear`;
- two *checkpoint conversion mappings* that reshape the ``proj`` weight/bias into the fused ``linear_proj`` (and
  back, for saving, using the reverse operations).

The whole mechanism is opt-in through the ``fusion_config`` argument of ``from_pretrained``.
"""

# Mutable module-level cache mapping a model class name to the discovered fusion candidates. It is intentionally a
# plain dict so tests can clear/patch it to guarantee isolation between test cases.
_FUSION_DISCOVERY_CACHE: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}

# Name of the attribute exposed on the (fused) patch embedding module.
_FUSED_LINEAR_ATTR = "linear_proj"


def _as_tuple(value) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Normalize a conv attribute (int or iterable) into a tuple of ints."""
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return tuple(int(v) for v in value)
    return (int(value),)


def _is_fusable_conv3d(module) -> bool:
    """A Conv3d is fusable when its stride matches its kernel size and it does not overlap/pad patches."""
    if not isinstance(module, nn.Conv3d):
        return False
    kernel_size = _as_tuple(module.kernel_size)
    stride = _as_tuple(module.stride)
    padding = _as_tuple(module.padding) if not isinstance(module.padding, str) else None
    dilation = _as_tuple(module.dilation)
    # stride must equal kernel size (non-overlapping), no padding and no dilation for an exact equivalence
    return (
        stride == kernel_size
        and padding is not None
        and all(p == 0 for p in padding)
        and all(d == 1 for d in dilation)
        and len(kernel_size) == 3
    )


def _build_probe_model(cls, config):
    """Instantiate ``cls`` on the meta device to inspect its modules without allocating real memory.

    Returns ``None`` if the model cannot be built (e.g. missing config fields), in which case discovery is skipped.
    """
    try:
        with torch.device("meta"):
            return cls(config)
    except Exception as error:  # pragma: no cover - defensive, discovery is best-effort
        logger.warning(
            f"Could not build a probe model for `{getattr(cls, '__name__', cls)}` to discover patch embedding "
            f"fusion candidates: {error}"
        )
        return None


def _discover_fusion_candidates(cls, config) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Discover every fusable Conv3d patch embedding in a model built from ``cls`` and ``config``.

    Each candidate is described by the parent (patch embedding) module class, the attribute name holding the
    Conv3d, and the parameters required to build the equivalent Linear / conversion operations.
    """
    cache_key = cls.__name__
    if cache_key in _FUSION_DISCOVERY_CACHE:
        return _FUSION_DISCOVERY_CACHE[cache_key]

    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    probe = _build_probe_model(cls, config)
    if probe is not None:
        # Map every module to its (parent, attribute_name) so we can locate the module owning a fusable Conv3d.
        parent_of = {}
        for parent in probe.modules():
            for attr_name, child in parent._modules.items():
                if child is not None:
                    parent_of[id(child)] = (parent, attr_name)

        seen_classes = set()
        for module in probe.modules():

                    "conv_attr": attr_name,
                    "in_channels": int(module.in_channels),
                    "out_channels": int(module.out_channels),
                    "kernel_size": _as_tuple(module.kernel_size),
                    "has_bias": module.bias is not None,
